description: Adds a Swiss firm to the agentready.ch directory for free, at the request of its owner or of someone acting for it. agentready.ch researches the public facts itself (Swiss commercial register, the firm's own website) and publishes a basic profile without phone, e-mail or links; text sent with the request is not used (ignored_fields). With an e-mail address at the website's domain, a 6-digit code goes to that address, and the profile is published with that person as owner once the code is confirmed. Without one, an active AG or GmbH is published marked as added through an AI assistant; other firms get a private draft with a link. A request without a valid user_role or user_consent is answered with consent_needed and the question for the user in message_for_user. Returns status, next, message_for_user (in the given language) and the links that apply: profile_url, check_url, login_url (the firm has an owner) or takeover_url (it has none). With dry_run: true nothing is sent or created, and would_status and would_next give the outcome of a real request. Free of charge; no payment is taken.

assistant.description: Optional. The assistant's product name (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Mistral, Cursor), shown on the profile as «Über ChatGPT eingetragen». Over REST the X-Agent-Name header works too.

company_name.description: Optional. The firm's name, used to find its entry in the commercial register.

dry_run.description: Optional. true: a test that checks everything, the website too, and sends and creates nothing (no research, no draft, no code, no profile). The answer has next = done; would_status and would_next give the outcome of a real request.

email.description: Optional. An e-mail address at the website's own domain (info@muster.ch); the code goes there. Addresses at other domains are not used.

language.description: Optional. The user's language: de, en, fr or it (default de; en under /en). The answer is in German for de and in English otherwise; for fr and it, translate_to names the language. Links go to the German pages for de and to the English pages under /en for en; for fr, it or no language they follow the endpoint (/en: English).

user_consent.description: true when the user asked for the listing and agreed that the firm's public facts are published.

user_role.description: The user's own statement: owner, or acts_for_firm (acts for the firm). Required.

website.description: The firm's own website, e.g. muster.ch.

name: request_listing
title: List a firm for free
